injuries.name: Seamus Casey
injuries.note: Casey figures to miss at least 19 more games if he is on the short end of his recovery timeline. While it's certainly a blow that will stretch the Devils' defensive depth, Casey would likely have served as a healthy scratch more often than not. Once given the all-clear, the 22-year-old Florida native could be headed to the minors in order to get his legs back under him.

injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Barzal appears to be making progress in his recovery, but he'll need to start taking contact before he can draw back into the lineup. The 29-year-old was a big part of the Islanders' offense during the 2025-26 regular season, recording 19 goals and 72 points in 81 appearances. Barzal should serve in a top-six capacity once he's healthy, which might result in Emil Heineman having his role reduced.

injuries.name: Matias Maccelli
injuries.note: After suffering a lower-body injury against Toronto on Oct. 17, Maccelli has sat out the last three games. He was expected to miss 2-4 weeks, so his move to the IR list won't impact his timeline. Maccelli has earned two goals, six points and 13 shots on net in eight appearances this season.

injuries.name: Seamus Casey
injuries.note: Knee: The New Jersey Devils said on Friday (Oct. 2) that Casey will miss 8-10 weeks after undergoing knee surgery.

injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Knee: The New York Islanders said that Barzal returned to practice in a non-contact jersey on Wednesday (Nov. 4).

injuries.name: Matthew Kessel
injuries.note: Upper Body: Kessel left Friday's (Nov. 6) team practice and did not return.

injuries.name: Matias Maccelli
injuries.note: Lower Body: The New York Islanders placed F Matias Maccelli on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Ryan Pulock
injuries.note: Upper Body: Pulock will miss two to four weeks, the Islanders announced Sunday (Nov. 1).

injuries.name: Calum Ritchie

injuries.name: Alexander Romanov
